rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for making or manufacturing a tangible product.

example.english: This factory can produce lots of toys.
example.traditional: 呢間工場製造好多玩具。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 coeng2 zai3 zou6 hou2 do1 wun2 geoi6

rows.note: Use this when something generates or brings about an effect, substance, or result rather than manufacturing an object.

example.english: This chemical reaction will produce heat.
example.traditional: 呢個化學反應會產生熱力。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 faa3 hok6 faan2 jing3 wui5 caan2 sang1 jit6 lik6

rows.note: Use this when making a person, witness, document, or other item available to someone.

example.english: Please produce your ID for the staff to check.
example.traditional: 請提供身份證畀職員核對。
example.jyutping: cing2 tai4 gung1 san1 fan6 zing3 bei2 zik1 jyun4 hat6 deoi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for creating and presenting a film, programme, or other media production.

example.english: A local team worked to produce this documentary.
example.traditional: 呢套紀錄片係本地團隊製作嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 hai6 bun2 dei6 tyun4 deoi6 zai3 zok3 ge3
